source: User-supplied chapter labels (2026-10-30, corrected twice). The local stage file encodes a map index in each base-36 stage id (id / 1000), so one stage name appears once per chapter with nothing to tell them apart. Map 3000 holds all three Empire of Cats chapters: they share stages 0-46, so only its Moons at 47, 49 and 50 carry a per-chapter label, keyed as map:index. Indexes not listed here have no label and fall back to their stats.
